chart + sources demo. el niño is ramping fast: ONI went from -0.61 (OND 2025) to +2.16 (JAS 2026). cpc gives 83% for ≥ +2.5 by OND.
OND 25 -0.61, NDJ -0.60, DJF 26 -0.39, JFM -0.21, FMA +0.11, MAM +0.46, AMJ +0.95, MJJ +1.39, JJA +1.80, JAS 26 +2.16
